source: A-Are you sure you wanna stay out here with me…? It’s pretty cold…
translation: 你、你确定要和我一起待在外面吗……？这里很冷……

source: I’m deliberately missing out on a life changing opportunity that everyone knows is best for me…
translation: 我正在故意错过一个能改变人生、所有人都知道最适合我的机会……

source: This was what Dad would’ve wanted for me… So I can't take this huge opportunity for granted...
translation: 这也是爸爸希望我走的路……所以我不能把这个重大机会视作理所当然……

source: You’ll be the best chef out there, I’m sure!
translation: 我相信你一定会成为最优秀的厨师！

source: And don’t worry about being away! We can always keep in touch, send gifts, and maybe even meet up at the restaurant you’ll be working in!
translation: 也别担心分隔两地！我们随时可以保持联系、互送礼物，甚至还可以在你工作的餐厅见面！
